option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathology results are consistent with amelanotic malignant melanoma, which is equivalent to malignant melanoma of the caruncle.
Caruncular melanoma is a subtype of malignant melanoma of the caruncle.
Amelanotic melanoma is a broader class that includes malignant melanoma of the caruncle.
Conjunctival melanoma (amelanotic variant) is not directly related to the clinical presentation and histopathology results.
